title: db.redis.apply — converge one Redis / Valkey instance (feature db.redis)
description: Writes /etc/redis/redis-kiln-<name>.conf (Valkey: /etc/valkey/valkey-kiln-<name>.conf), 0640 owned by the engine user, with the data in /var/lib/<engine>/kiln-<name>; enables and starts the distribution's template unit <engine>-server@kiln-<name>, restarting it only when the file changed, and waits for PING with the password. CONFIG, DEBUG, MODULE and SHUTDOWN are disabled in the instance. Fails with 'port N is in use by <process>' when another process holds the port. The stock instance on 6379 is never touched.

password.description: requirepass of the default user. Written to the config file only; redis-cli gets it through REDISCLI_AUTH

bind.description: Addresses to listen on. 127.0.0.1 is always included; absent = 127.0.0.1 only. Who can reach them is up to the firewall

persistence.description: rdb: snapshots (save 3600 1 300 100 60 10000); aof: append-only file, fsync every second; none: in memory only

changed.description: true when the configuration changed or the instance was (re)started
